mannequin.glb is derived from UAL1_Standard.glb of the Universal Animation Library [Standard]
by Quaternius (https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library,
https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary.html), downloaded on 18 Oct 2026.

Kept: the Mannequin mesh and skeleton and four clips (Idle_Loop, Walk_Loop, Jog_Fwd_Loop,
Sprint_Loop); everything else removed and the file quantised with gltf-transform 4.5.1.

The License.txt shipped in the pack reads:
